sampled.task: First successful contact on a different job within 24 hours, conditional on such an outcome; not generic next-action prediction
sampled.seen_policy: Target and negatives exclude any user-item interaction at or before source timestamp
sampled.catalog_policy: Items first observed strictly before the training cutoff
sampled.followup_policy: Complete 24-hour horizon strictly before each partition endpoint
sampled.case_policy: First eligible source attempt per user and split after model-independent eligibility filters
sampled.sampling_policy: 999 distinct unobserved items without replacement; per-attempt SeedSequence
sampled.negative_interpretation: Unobserved comparison items, not verified dislikes; other future positives are not excluded using future information

development_selection.scope: Common tuning cohort for all full-catalog comparators; remaining development users are not an independent holdout
